name: Base64 Toolkit
summary: Offline Base64 encoder/decoder with standard and URL-safe variants.

manifest.json.name: Base64 Toolkit
manifest.json.author: local
manifest.json.description: Offline Base64 encoder/decoder with standard and URL-safe variants.

config.script:
import base64, binascii
text = base64.b64decode("{{selection.text.b64}}").decode("utf-8", "replace")
raw = text.strip()
print("BASE64 TOOLKIT")
if not raw:
    print("No selected text.")
    raise SystemExit

def decode_candidate(label, value, decoder):
    try:
        padded = value + "=" * (-len(value) % 4)
        decoded = decoder(padded.encode())
        preview = decoded.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        printable = sum(1 for ch in preview if ch.isprintable() or ch in "\r\n\t")
        ratio = printable / max(len(preview), 1)
        print(f"{label}: decoded {len(decoded)} bytes, printable={ratio:.0%}")
        print(preview[:2000])
    except (binascii.Error, ValueError, UnicodeError):
        print(f"{label}: not valid")

print(f"Input chars: {len(raw)}")
print()
decode_candidate("standard decode", raw, base64.b64decode)
print()
decode_candidate("url-safe decode", raw, base64.urlsafe_b64decode)
print()
print("standard encode:")
print(base64.b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode())
print()
print("url-safe encode:")
print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(text.encode("utf-8")).decode().rstrip("="))
